title: Rezoning map change for 158-06 Northern Boulevard, Queens
summary: This zoning map amendment would change R5B, C1-2 and R2 districts to R7A and C2-4 districts at 158-06 Northern Boulevard in Murray Hill, Queens. It would enable a new 10-story mixed-use building with about 70,765 square feet of floor area and 76 apartments, including 19 income-restricted units. The Council held a public hearing on August 12, 2026 and the committee recommended approval with modifications on September 24, 2026.
